name: Jet Venture 1
decision_note: Brno-based B2B/industrial-tech VC fund of the Jet Investment group with its own Jet Ventures team (brand rule); over EUR 30m raised in its first fundraising round and eleven investments, incl. Czech DecisionRules and IAG (June 2026) and AppNava (Sep 2026).

legal_entities.name: Jet Venture 1 fond fondů, otevřený podílový fond

evidence.quote: We invest in high-growth B2B and industrial-tech start-ups based in the industrial heartland of Europe: Czechia, Poland, Austria, Germany, and Slovakia.
We support ambitious start-ups in late-seed to Series A stages in the industrial-tech/B2B to achieve their global ambitions.
Our initial investment can reach up to 2M EUR, and we are flexible in leading the round or co-investing to fuel your growth.
Fond Jet Venture 1 cílí na velikost padesát milionů eur (zhruba 1,2 miliardy korun) a už po prvním kole fundraisingu má k dispozici přes třicet milionů eur.

Z toho máme aktuálně zainvestovaných zhruba devět a půl milionu eur rozdělených do šesti společností, což odpovídá naší ideální velikosti ticketu, kdy se chceme u jedné investice pohybovat mezi jedním a dvěma miliony eur.
Jet jako hlavní investor vložil 1,8 milionu dolarů (38 milionů korun), zhruba čtyři pětiny kola, které doplnil fond Arya Women.

(Brno, September 1, 2026) The Jet Investment has made its tenth investment through the Jet Venture 1 SICAV venture capital fund investing €2.1 million in Phantasma Labs, a Berlin-based startup developing artificial intelligence for production planning and scheduling in manufacturing.
Český technologický startup DecisionRules získává investici ve výši 1,5 milionu eur (36 milionů korun) od brněnské skupiny Jet Investment, respektive jejího venture kapitálového fondu Jet Venture 1.
Kapitál poskytly fondy Orbit Capital a Jet Venture 1 prostřednictvím kombinace klasické kapitálové investice a takzvaného venture debt financování.

analyst_notes: Brand rule: Jet Ventures / Jet Venture 1 is the separately branded VC fund of the Brno PE group Jet Investment (record jet-investment, S1 pe) with its own site and team (Managing Partner Kamil Levinský, four-person team per CzechCrunch 2025-12-18); the investment committee includes Jet Investment partners. The jet-investment record still lists 'Jet Ventures' as an alias and Jet Venture 1 SICAV (22030417) as a fund entity - overlap to be resolved in that record's re-audit. Capital: over EUR 30m available after the first fundraising round (interview 2025-12-18; recorded as 30m interim_close, as_of = article date because the close date is not given); EUR 50m is the target (expected to be reached during 2026), recorded as a target only. Ticket: site says initial investment up to EUR 2M (separate block: 'Up to EUR 2.5M per start-up'); the interview gives an ideal ticket of EUR 1-2m - used as min/max. Stage: site says late-seed to Series A; fund page asks for about EUR 1m revenue and 100% growth. Investments (round_amount = whole round): AppNava USD 2.3m (Jet USD 1.8m lead; eleventh investment, Jet press release 2026-09-17); Phantasma Labs EUR 2.6m (Jet EUR 2.1m, tenth investment; round total in the next sentence of the same press release); DecisionRules EUR 1.5m from Jet (CzechCrunch 2026-06-23, Jet press release 2026-06-24); IAG EUR 6m from Orbit Capital and Jet Venture 1 combined (equity + venture debt; Jet holds 8.9%; follow-on to a EUR 5m round in May 2025). Also seen: GigaScan (SE, EUR 2.1m) and Hermetiq (US, USD 750k) both 2026-08-26 per Jet news list; Digicust (AT, EUR 950k, December 2025). Legal entities: Jet Venture 1 SICAV, a.s. and its sub-fund (ARES); Jet Investment, a.s. is the manager; Jet Venture 1 Founders, a.s. (2025) role unknown; Jet Venture 1 fond fondů OPF sits at Conseq's address and is presumably the Conseq feeder fund mentioned by CzechCrunch 2026-01-07 (minimum CZK 1m) - role 'other'.
